verdict.rationale: Zero documents a programmatic interface, ZeroMCP, that exposes broad mailbox operations: listing and reading threads, composing and sending, drafts, deleting, labels, read/unread, bulk archive/delete, and search. An AI-native user can therefore drive much of the product programmatically. However, this interface is an MCP tool surface rather than a documented general-purpose public API. Authentication works only by pasting a browser session cookie into the Authorization header, and OAuth is listed as 'coming soon'. missing for 10: a documented general-purpose public API (e.g. REST/GraphQL reference with endpoints and schemas), proper API-key or OAuth authentication, versioning/stability guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.
